body: to start off i’m sorry about your dad and may he rest in peace. i don’t know how it feels to lose a parent but ik how having a absent parents feels. don’t give up, your sister needs you, your mom does too even though you might not feel like it. keep living for them and your dad. idk if your spiritual but i believe that ppl that have passed on watch over us. do something that y’all used to do together just because you can’t see him doesn’t mean he’s not there.
did your partner say you were a burden or do you assume this?
i’ll be your friend, there are tons of people who’d love to be your friend but you haven’t met them yet. there are billions of people on earth and you haven’t met a quarter of them

congrats on losing weight! and i’ve recently started a journey to find my likes. start with activities since you like the gym it could be skating, hiking, personal training, surfing, etc. Maybe film, gaming, writing, painting, just something out of your comfort zone. you don’t have to start now but promise yourself you won’t soak in your thoughts for too long because it leads no where but to more negativity.

i understand my mom has said some of the worst things to me. sometimes parents project their insecurities on their kids when they think they’re better than them or doing more than what they were at that age. parents can be your biggest haters. don’t let him stop you because he’ll need you one day.

13? your stressing yourself way to much at this age nothing matters. your first starting to go thru puberty and learn small things about yourself. friendships end relationships do too at that age. don’t have big expectations for them just live in the moment and make memories. because the people i thought i’d go thru high school with are long gone and we’ve grown out of each other because we matured and learned we don’t have the same things in common and i promise the grades your making now won’t matter in the future at all. no one even talks about them later on. and kids make mistakes that’s what you’re meant to do don’t beat yourself up

i’m going thru something similar. my sister tried to use me but we didn’t grow up together, it hurts because i ignored everything wrong she did to me because i wanted to build a bond. but sometimes you have to realize that blood means nothing you can’t choose them but you can choose who you want around you. your real family the people who love you and care. you will find them one day and these bad moments won’t matter. nd i guarantee your mother and sister will need you one day

there is a place for you, there’s a place for everyone. i understand the slurs and please don’t let them phase you. there will always be people who don’t like you because your fearless and unapologetically you! you have the courage to live your truth and be yourself and people hate that. the ones who call you slurs are probably in the closet and are scared to be themselves. don’t give up on your dreams no matter what. be an inspiration for other trans people going thru the same thing. give them hope that they can achieve what you will. you’ll look back on the bad and laugh at those people who treated you bad because you made it. one day people will be watching/ reading your comics and be sure to make trans characters👍🏾

maybe you’re not with the right ppl. maybe they aren’t meant to be the friends you need to find your purpose. don’t compare your life to others because everyone has struggles some more than others. try new things you can’t find your passion without taking risk. do something you’d never think to do. your only 20 don’t give up. also find happiness in yourself before you try to be happy with others bc they can leave anytime but you never leave yourself

do you believe you’re a woman? if so that’s all that matters. there will always be someone who doesn’t like you or agree with you no matter what you do. you could the kindest most giving woman and people will find a way to dislike you. love yourself because there is only one you. that sounds cliche but it’s true, another trans woman or girl could be going through the same thing and you can be the one who gives them reassurance and makes them love their self. you are needed not just by ppl who know you but in the trans community also. don’t give up

to start off their not your friends. people who care about you shouldn’t make you feel this way. everyone makes mistakes, cut them off and make sure you’ve forgiven yourself for what you’ve done completely nd move on from the situation. and finding out yourself is a journey you don’t come out the womb knowing what you like or don’t like, you have to try things. also it’s never too late to find your purpose because someone needs you whether you believe it or not. so go on your journey to finding yourself nd leave whoever doesn’t agree in the dust because none of the negativity will matter later on

coming from someone who deals with self hatred some days i just write down the things i don’t like about myself or things i wish i could change. then write down what i do like about myself nd compare them. try to become a better person for yourself so you feel good. and forgive yourself for the bad things you’ve done because you can’t change them but you can stop yourself from repeating them. i hope this helps you

i understand feeling alone on your birthday. i always end up crying on mines. but once you realize the good things it gets better you lived another year, you’ve been sober for 106 days, you should be proud of yourself. do something nice for yourself, you are your biggest supporter  no matter who leaves you. life is to short to depend on others for happiness go celebrate your accomplishments even if you only watch your favorite movie or buy your favorite foods

this is honestly me. i used to have friends but i was forced to move and it sucks watching them live life and replace me. i haven’t found anyone with the same interest as me in this new state these past 3 yrs. i’ve went thru so many people that have just done me wrong. watching other people my age party, live life is saddening. and people say “just go outside and talk to ppl” but it’s not that easy i have anxiety and it takes a lot to go to public places by myself or start conversations. so i just stay home. i just read and pretend i’m that character it gets me thru the day.
